metadata.description: PCC (Pre Commit Check) protocol - a commit-gate skill for Claude Code

plugins.name: pcc
plugins.description: Commit-gate protocol: gate/sweep/baseline tiers, an order that is never rearranged, narrow-in-loop/wide-at-end speed rules that survive a red verdict, a commit-keyed selector baseline, an external-dependency probe before long suites, and read-the-artifact evidence rules. Stack-agnostic - project-specific commands come from the repo's own adapter.
